muktaiwari.title: Muktainagar Wari
muktaiwari.description: Muktainagar is named after Saint Muktai, a revered saint of the Warkari tradition. Devotees honor her by offering devotional visits or 'Wari' at her temple in Jalgaon district.
muktaiwari.importance1: Respect for Saint Muktai: The city was renamed in her honor.
muktaiwari.importance2: Spiritual Center: The temple of Saint Muktai is a major pilgrimage site.
muktaiwari.wari1: Devotional visits: Pilgrims travel to the temple as part of the Wari.
muktaiwari.wari2: Pilgrimage: They participate in devotional practices.
muktaiwari.wari3: Palkhi Procession: Annual procession with rituals and celebrations.
muktaiwari.wari4: Abhangas: Pilgrims sing devotional songs written by Saint Muktai.
muktaiwari.wari5: Inclusivity: Both men and women participate equally.

HOME.ABHANG:
The yogi purifies the mind, bearing the faults of mankind.
When worldly passions burn like fire, saints turn them into cooling water.
Words like weapons cause distress, but saints give guiding counsel.
The cosmic veil is bound by Brahman’s thread — open the gate, O Jnaneshwar.

Know the true saint in the world: compassion and forgiveness dwell in him.
Greed and pride find no place in his heart; he alone is detached in life.
In both worlds he remains blissful, with pure knowledge upon his lips.
False imaginations vanish away — open the gate, O Jnaneshwar.
HOME.SAINT_DESC: Saint Muktabai, also known as Muktai, was a revered 13th-century saint in the Varkari tradition and the younger sister of Saint Dnyaneshwar. She is celebrated for her deep spiritual insight and poetic contributions, which continue to inspire followers of the Bhakti movement. One of the prominent temples dedicated to her is located in Mehun, near Muktainagar in the Jalgaon district of Maharashtra.
HOME.ASHADI_EVENT_DESC: On Ashadhi Ekadashi, a special event is held where Saint Muktabai is adorned with dates. Around 125 kg of fresh dates are used, traditionally offered from a devotee’s farm. Devotees believe that those who cannot visit Pandharpur receive the same blessings by visiting Muktabai.

HOME.BY_ROAD_DESC: Accessible via road from Jalgaon, Bhusawal, and Muktainagar.
HOME.BY_TRAIN_DESC: Nearest railway stations are Bhusawal and Jalgaon.
HOME.BY_AIR_DESC: Closest airports are Aurangabad and Nagpur.

ABHANG.LINE1: Detached from worldly life, through chanting Hari’s name, one attains Vaikuntha, liberation assured. (1)
ABHANG.LINE2: Without Hari, liberation is never possible; he destroys the bondage of worldly suffering. (2)
ABHANG.LINE3: In despair and hopelessness, unconsciousness prevails; Hari awakens us in his own divine form. (3)
ABHANG.LINE4: Muktai is ever a living liberated soul, breaking all subtle distinctions anew. (4)
